newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Manhattan begins timber production.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Manhattan begins timber production.

text.p: Nevada Manhattan Mining Inc said Friday its 80 percent-owned subsidiary, Equatorial Resources, has started sawn timber production.
Initial production is forecasted at 2,800 cubic meters per month of hard wood timber from the previously announced 276,000 hectares (690,000 acres) in the Amazon Basin of Brazil, the company said.
It said average net selling prices are estimated at $500 per cubic meter of which the company will net $200 per cubic meter.
With inquiries for orders well in excess of the present production capacity, the company plans an immediate increase in milling capability, its statement said.

Nevada Manhattan also said it has traded its previously announced exploration rights of 10,000 hectares (25,000 acres) in East Kalimantan, Indonesia, for a property consisting of over 16,000 hectares (40,000 acres) in two parcels.

These properties located in the southeast section of the Kalimantan Gold Belt increase the company's holdings in Kalimantan by 60 percent. This trade was negotiated through the company's agreement with Maxwell's Energy Metals and Technology Ltd. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
